title: applied-ml-weekly-notes-2026-03-24
content:
Applied ML weekly notes — 2026-03-24

Attendees / quick notes: Avery Chen (owner), Priya Nair, Miguel Santos, Elena Garcia, Samir Patel (infra).

This doc is a working log of quantization experiments, eval results, and model onboarding progress from this week. Lots of rough notes + action items — majority exploratory.

1) Quantization experiments (summary)
- Goal: get 4-bit/8-bit quantized variants of Mistral-7B and Llama-2-13B working in our runtime with minimal quality regression and measurable latency/memory improvements.
- Setup: local cluster (p3d.24xlarge equiv.), tuned GEMM kernels branch (quant-kernels v2), GPTQ-style post-training quant (per-channel and per-token group).
- Key runs and outcomes:
  - run q8-mistral-v1: 8-bit symmetric per-channel, no calibration sets used initially. Observed ~1.9GB GPU memory reduction and 1.6x token throughput improvement vs fp16 on our 8k context path. Quality: negligible change on Rouge/QA microbenchmarks (delta < 0.5%).
  - run q4-mistral-gptq: 4-bit GPTQ with per-block scale. Memory: ~3.8x reduction vs fp16 (fits 2x batch on single GPU). Throughput: 2.7x improvement but tail-latency on generation increased for some prompts (50-95th pctl delta +15ms).
  - run q8-llama13b: stability issues observed — hallucination increase on closed-book QA by ~3% absolute (worse than tolerance). Kernel fallback to fp16 improved accuracy but lost latency benefit.

- Notes / root causes under investigation:
  - Quantized kernel alignment bug: Samir traced a fragmentation issue when allocating KV cache for quantized models in our allocator (related to cudaMallocAsync fragmentation behavior when tensor shapes vary per step). Repro on smaller repro case created (linked PR).
  - Calibration data matters: initial q8 runs lacked prompt-style calibration; adding a 1k prompt calibration set reduced QA drift significantly. Need to standardize calibration harness.
  - Per-channel vs per-token-group tradeoffs: per-channel more stable for generative tasks, per-token-group had better peak compression but higher variance.

2) Eval pipeline runs and metrics
- Eval targets: NQ-style QA set (internal), Redwood-chat-eval (multi-turn helpfulness + safety), and latency/throughput on synthetic prompt mixes.
- Latest eval snapshot (EVAL_RUN: eval-2026-03-23-001):
  - q8-mistral-v1: QA EM - baseline(fp16)=72.1 -> q8=71.6 (delta -0.5), Redwood chat helpfulness -0.8% absolute, safety pass unchanged. P95 latency (1k context) = 210ms -> q8 = 140ms.
  - q4-mistral-gptq: QA EM = 69.9 (delta -2.2), more variability on multi-turn conversational coherence (flagged). P95 latency = 120ms but with occasional tail spikes.
  - q8-llama13b: QA EM delta -3.0; DO NOT promote until calibration/ker nel changes.

- Passing criteria proposal for promoting a quantized variant to nightly serving: QA EM delta <= 1.0 absolute, Redwood-chat helpfulness delta <= 1.0 abs, no safety regressions, P95 latency improvement >= 30% vs fp16. Team agreed in meeting to adopt these for next week.

3) Model onboarding status (Mistral-7B and Llama-2-13B)
- Mistral-7B: model files uploaded to model-store (v0.1), tokenizer checks done, conversion to diff format completed. Onboarding PR open (GITHUB PR #86). Need to add quantized variants to catalog page and run compatibility tests on Dedicated nodes.
- Llama-2-13B: full fp16 baseline validated on hosted infra. Quantization failures blocking promotion — see above. Also need license/LSA check for 13B variant (legal sign-off pending JIRA MLINF-421).

4) Standup / synchronization notes (short bullets)
- Priya: focused on improving calibration harness and curating 1k prompt calibration set (diverse domain mix). Expect to land scripts by Tue 3/26.
- Miguel: tuned quant-kernels v2; found allocator fragmentation pattern; opened PR to add pool-based allocator fallback. Linked PR: github.com/redwood-inference/quant-kernels/pull/88.
- Elena: ran large-batch evals on Dedicated simulators; found q4 tail-latency spikes correlated with specific prompt length transitions. Will add guardrails in runtime for batch-splitting.
- Samir: infra repro + smaller regression test; repro case added to CI (cpu-only smoke) to avoid blocking other teams.

5) Decisions made in meeting
- Freeze q8-mistral-v1 as a candidate for canary on Hosted API next week pending final calibration and one more eval run. Canary will be limited to <5% traffic and 10s window rollout.
- Do NOT promote q4-mistral-gptq to canary until we address coherence regressions and tail spikes. Continue offline research.
- Block onboarding of llama-2-13b quantized variants until allocator bug fixed and legal sign-off obtained.

6) Action items (owners + ETA)
- Priya: finalize calibration dataset and upload to S3 + add calibration stage to eval harness (ETA 2026-03-26).
- Miguel: merge allocator fallback PR or provide workaround (ETA 2026-03-25) and coordinate with Samir to run Dedicated smoke.
- Elena: add batch-splitting guardrail to runtime and run targeted tail-latency tests (ETA 2026-03-27).
- Avery: prepare canary rollout plan and dashboard (cost/latency/quality) for hosted API (ETA 2026-03-28).
- Legal (cc: product-security): complete license check for Llama-2-13B (JIRA MLINF-421) (ETA 2026-03-30).

7) Open questions / research directions
- Can we get q4 stable for multi-turn chat with a hybrid approach (KV cache fp16 + matmul q4)? Need to prototype mixed-precision path in runtime.
- Is there an automated calibration sampler we can integrate into onboarding to avoid ad hoc prompt selection? Priya to explore sampling heuristics.
- Tradeoffs between batch-splitting vs dynamic padding for tail latency — Elena to produce microbench comparison.

8) Notes to self / TODOs for next week
- Run one full-nightly eval for q8-mistral after calibration harness lands; include safety + hallucination detectors.
- Add a small test to CI to prevent allocator regression from being merged without reproducible benchmark.
- Draft short one-pager for the console team on what metrics we need for canary dashboard (per-route token-cost, token-latency percentiles, quality deltas).

Appendix: quick log of short standup updates over the week
- Mon 3/23: initial full-run quant tests, found q4 instability on convo.
- Tue 3/24: allocator fragmentation repro found, PR opened.
- Wed 3/25: calibration harness improvements landed in branch (Priya), reruns scheduled.
- Thu 3/26: planned canary doc review with console + infra.

If anything missing or you want raw logs (perf traces / repro scripts), ask and I will paste snippets here — keeping this doc lightweight.
